title: n6 raw histogram mode
description:
The N6 core commit (395d819) added core/src/RawStats.cpp to the
desktop build (tools/build-desktop.sh compiles core sources
directly) but never registered it in core/CMakeLists.txt — the
build the Android app consumes via add_subdirectory from
app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt. The JNI bridge's new
nativeRawHistogram calls rawedit::rawHistogramStats, so the NDK
link of librawedit_jni.so failed with an undefined symbol:

  ld.lld: error: undefined symbol:
  rawedit::rawHistogramStats(unsigned short const*, unsigned int,
  unsigned int, rawedit::CfaPattern, int const*, int const*, int, int)

Caught by the required combined gradle verify
(:app:assembleDebug); the desktop verify alone could not see it.

Adds src/RawStats.cpp to the rawedit static library's source list
and names its consumer in the lib's comment block, matching the
existing per-file annotation style.
changed: feat: raw cfa histogram stats core
feat: raw histogram jni and session seam
fix: register rawstats in core cmake
